bullets.text: In Pallikaranai, 300 people received appointment orders at a free job camp; the office should track local employment outcomes.
A white-tailed sea eagle was sighted for the first time in Pallikaranai marshland, and the office should watch conservation efforts.
In Thiruvallur, police recovered 43 sovereigns of gold buried in the ground after a theft at a teacher's house, and the office should monitor the case.
Pattabiram residents urged the Highways Department to build a roundabout on CTH Road, and the office should follow up with officials.
Vehicle users faced severe traffic congestion in Thiruthani, and the office should coordinate with traffic authorities for relief measures.
President Trump threatened taxes on US firms building AI data centers abroad, and the office should monitor global investment impacts.
Prime Minister Modi stated that AI cannot take jobs from skilled workers, and the office should watch skill development programs.
